news.headline: Banks vs NBFCs: Which stocks could benefit as RBI eyes rate hike for first time in 3 years?
news.summary: The RBI’s expected first rate hike in three years could have a mixed impact on banks and NBFCs. While higher funding costs may pressure NBFC margins, lenders with floating-rate assets and strong liquidity could benefit. Brokerages favour HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance and Tata Capital.

news.headline: India bonds slip as traders wait for hawkish central bank action
news.summary: Indian government bonds have seen a downward trend as market participants speculated on tighter monetary policies from the central bank. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 benchmark bond climbed to 7.2213%. Analysts forecast a 25 basis point boost in the RBI's key policy rate. Investors are attentively looking for additional liquidity strategies from the RBI, with future outcomes expected to depend significantly on inflation and growth outlooks.

news.headline: Ambani’s Jio said to seek about Rs 11 lakh crore valuation in IPO
news.summary: Jio Platforms is reportedly seeking a valuation of around Rs 11 lakh crore for its planned IPO, below earlier estimates of up to $170 billion. The telecom and digital services arm of Reliance Industries could launch the issue in the week of October 19 and list before October 30, Bloomberg reported.

news.headline: Explained: How RBI rate hike may impact Sensex, Nifty after 8-week losing streak
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to announce a 25-basis point rate hike in its upcoming meeting. Analysts assert that this rate hike has already been largely priced into the stock market. While sectors such as real estate and autos may experience some volatility, clean balance sheets could mitigate impacts. The market's movement will depend more on corporate earnings than on monetary policy adjustments.

news.headline: Indian banks face a Q2 paradox: FCNR boosts loan growth but margins shrink
news.summary: Indian banks are heading into the Q2 earnings season with strong loan growth, helped by FCNR(B) deposit inflows, but margins are likely to remain under pressure. Analysts expect healthy earnings growth on lower credit costs and stable asset quality, while favouring large private banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.

news.headline: Global Market:  BOJ seen nearing 2% inflation target as markets eye December rate hike
news.summary: The Bank of Japan may signal later this month that underlying inflation has reached its 2% target, strengthening expectations for a December rate hike. While policymakers remain cautious after recent increases, steady wages, rising prices and yen weakness could support further tightening as the BOJ gradually normalises monetary policy.

news.headline: How Jefferies is reshuffling its portfolio as soaring bond yields give Nifty bulls sleepless nights
news.summary: Jefferies is favouring largecaps as rising bond yields pressure Indian equities, citing relatively attractive valuations and a narrowing earnings gap with midcaps. The brokerage has added Kotak Mahindra Bank and Reliance Industries to its preferred portfolio.

news.headline: Global Market | Central banks face tougher crisis-management role as public debt rises: BIS chief
news.summary: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos warned that future financial crises could be harder to manage amid soaring public debt, fiscal deficits and volatile bond markets. Growing non-bank financial risks and rapid technologies could accelerate turmoil. He urged stronger regulation, coordinated government action and international cooperation to preserve central banks’ crisis-management capabilities.

news.headline: Vedanta shares jump 3% as firm fixes record date for first dividend after demerger. What to expect?
news.summary: Vedanta shares rose over 3% after the company set October 14 as the record date for its first FY27 interim dividend, subject to board approval on October 8. The payout will be the first since Vedanta’s demerger into five entities. Analysts expect dividends to remain strong but potentially become more volatile and commodity-sensitive.

news.headline: CAS U-turn ahead? BSE, Groww, NSE, other capital market stocks jump up to 4% amid buzz around Sebi tweaking F&O settlement rules
news.summary: Capital market stocks rallied after a Reuters report said Sebi may partly reverse its new Closing Auction Session rules for derivatives settlement. BSE, NSE, Groww and Angel One gained as options volumes recovered and CAS-related concerns eased.

news.headline: Rupee slips to over 2-month low on portfolio outflows, RBI likely steps in
news.summary: The Indian rupee faced a setback on Tuesday, falling to its weakest position in more than two months. Continuous foreign divestment in local assets heightened pressure on the currency, igniting discussions of possible intervention from the central bank. Analysts foresee a cautious depreciation of the rupee throughout the upcoming year, bolstered by positive capital inflows into foreign reserves.

news.headline: Vinir Engineering files DRHP with SEBI for fresh issue of up to 7.1 crore shares
news.summary: Vinir Engineering has filed its DRHP with Sebi for an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to 7.1 crore shares, with proceeds earmarked for plant and machinery, working capital, acquisitions and general corporate purposes.

news.headline: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Share Price Live Updates: Compliances-Half Yearly Report (SEBI Circular No. CIR/IMD/DF-1/67/2017)
SRIT India shares hit 5% upper circuit after strong debut, jump 19% from IPO price. Should you buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: SRIT India shares rose 19% from the IPO price after making a strong debut on the NSE. The stock, however, fell short of grey market expectations. With the company’s digital technology services business gaining traction, analysts highlight revenue growth, profitability, execution and cash flows as key factors for investors.

news.headline: Orient Cables shares tumble 10% a day after strong market debut
news.summary: Orient Cables' shares faced a notable drop of 10% soon after a promising IPO launch, leading to a dip in investor sentiment. However, the stock continues to hold firm above the initial issue price of Rs 272. Analysts are now focused on the firm’s capability to maintain revenue growth and its profitability, urging investors to carefully evaluate its financial soundness and operational strategies in the near future.
